interface.title: Batch Process Analytics (SPC × ML)
interface.field: Pharmaceutical manufacturing / process engineering (Quality-by-Design, solid oral dose tablets)
interface.stage_of_work: Monitoring and investigating a production process after qualification: finding when it drifted, then working out why
interface.what_it_is_for: Shows when a batch manufacturing process went out of statistical control (individuals control charts with Western Electric rules, and capability) and suggests which process parameters caused the shift (XGBoost + SHAP), with a batch table that can be filtered and exported. The footer and README say I-MR, but only the individuals (I) chart is drawn; there is no moving-range panel.

data.note: Synthetic demo data loads on its own: Acetriptan 50 mg IR Tablet, Line-02, 220 batches, Jan 2024 – Oct 2025, labelled 'SYNTHETIC DEMO DATA'. The interface has no upload control. Control limits come from the first 80 qualification batches.

tree.general: Find when a batch process drifted out of control and explain why
tree.specific: Use SPC charts, Cpk/Ppk and an XGBoost+SHAP driver model to explain the drop in dissolution on Line-02 for Acetriptan 50 mg tablets
